articles.title: Seven People Are Running to Lead the United Nations
articles.summary: Seven candidates are competing to become the next secretary-general of the United Nations, and four of them are women. The winner could be the first woman to lead the 81-year-old organization.

articles.title: White House Uses Taxpayer Money for Pro-Trump TV Ads
articles.summary: The White House is spending public money on TV ads that look like campaign ads for President Trump. The ads have cost at least $1.4 million so far and are airing during NFL games and other big shows. Even some Republicans say it's wrong.

articles.title: Hurricane Polo's Leftover Rain Floods the Southwest
articles.summary: Hurricane Polo hit Mexico with 110 mph winds, then its leftover rain flooded New Mexico, Arizona and Utah. Hundreds of people in small towns near the Rio Grande had to leave their homes because a dam might break.
